findings.detail: pwsh.exe (PowerShell 7) or powershell_ise.exe spawned from an Office app bypasses the Image filter, and -ec / -e short forms bypass the CommandLine filter
findings.fix_hint: Match Image on pwsh.exe and powershell_ise.exe as well, and match the -e/-ec/-enc/-EncodedCommand prefix case-insensitively with a regex
